question: As of December 2022, who among the following is the Governor of West Bengal, India?
solution:
The correct answer is **CV Ananda Bose** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **CV Ananda Bose​**** **is the current **Governor** of **West Bengal, **India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Ashok Gehlot **is the Former **Chief Minister of Rajasthan**, India.
 
• **Jagdeep Dhankar** is Former of **Governor of West Bengal, and Currently serving as ****Vice President of India​. **
 
• **Mamata Banerjee** is the current **Chief Minister of West Bengal **and not the Governor.
